figures.observation: Environment boundary encloses dashed fast and slow boxes joined by plain Interface & Interaction line. Green control circle below has dotted connections to both boxes and interface-line midpoint; no arrowheads.

Environment encloses head with three colored puzzle pieces. System-label arrows point into corresponding pieces, not between systems. Sensory/cognitive and role-attribute labels surround the head; source labels include Rationale and Bounded rationale.
Users point through one right-facing arrow into AI System Architecture, containing parallel Application, Data and Algorithm Architecture pillars with no arrows between pillars.

Interaction spans Human, Technology and Facility columns. Black arrows highlight Decision and Algorithm additions, not flows. Environment, Protection and Observability span the base above System or ecosystem label.

Initiate, Discover and Implement are three side-by-side panels; a horizontal double-headed Govern & Adapt arrow spans all three. Text calls these five iterative stages; Govern/Adapt are not downstream-only boxes.
